title: Orsen and the Playlist
premise: Petra Okafor just wants to survive senior year at Hollowmere Academy, a school built atop the ruins of a burned-down conservatory. When a group chat called 'the Playlist' starts sending him songs days before the events they describe, he discovers the messages come from Orsen, a student who vanished decades ago and whose loyalty to a friend cost him everything. Petra's new friendships — especially with archivist Wren — deepen even as the Playlist's predictions turn dark, and he realizes the only way to free Orsen is to expose a truth the school's founding families, including his own benefactor, buried. In the end Petra chooses truth over belonging, breaking the loop at the cost of his scholarship and nearly his closest friendship, and Orsen's name is finally spoken aloud.
about_author: Wendell Thackeray is a former school librarian from coastal Maine who spent years collecting student folklore before writing it down. He writes quiet supernatural stories about the things institutions would rather forget.

chapters.title: One Hundred and Sixty-Two Days
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. He counts down to graduation, invisible at Hollowmere Academy, where he's a scholarship kid among founding-family legacies. A tour of the archives with Wren reveals the school was built over a burned conservatory. Emotional beat: restless isolation, the first crack of curiosity about the place he resents.

chapters.title: The Group Chat Nobody Made
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. An unknown number adds him to a chat called 'the Playlist' that sends a single song title — then a girl's locker floods exactly as the lyrics described. Wren confirms the chat existed in a 1974 yearbook, with a student named Orsen listed as admin. Emotional beat: eerie fascination overriding skepticism.

chapters.title: Orsen Vale, Missing Since Spring
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. She digs into the conservatory fire and finds Orsen Vale, a music prodigy whose disappearance preceded the blaze and was quietly erased from records. Petra starts receiving songs that predict smaller, harmless events. Emotional beat: the thrill of a shared secret becoming a real friendship.

chapters.title: Loyalty, Per the Handbook
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Headmaster Aldous Crane — the Okafor family's benefactor — warns Petra away from the archives, offering him a guaranteed future if he stays loyal to the school. That night the Playlist sends a song predicting a fall from the music hall balcony. Emotional beat: the first hint that belonging has a price.

chapters.title: The Song That Saved Dev
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Petra intercepts his friend Dev on the balcony seconds before the railing gives way. Dev, shaken and grateful, swears secrecy — but Crane notices Petra's new habit of arriving before accidents. Emotional beat: triumph curdling into fear, because the Playlist is escalating.

chapters.title: What Orsen Wouldn't Say
chapters.summary: Orsen's POV, first time. Through a dreamlike interlude, Orsen relives the fire: he covered for his best friend, the headmaster's son, who set it, and paid with his name, his future, and finally his life. He can only speak in songs. Emotional beat: grief and the weight of a loyalty that became a cage.

chapters.title: The Recording in the Wall
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Wren and Petra find Orsen's hidden reel-to-reel confession inside the conservatory ruins beneath the music hall — naming the arsonist, now a powerful alumnus and Crane's mentor. Crane catches them and threatens expulsion and revocation of Petra's scholarship. Emotional beat: cornered defiance.

chapters.title: Dev, Asked to Choose
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Crane pressures Dev to report Petra for trespassing, weaponizing Dev's scholarship the same way Orsen was leveraged generations ago. Dev hesitates, and the Playlist sends its darkest prediction yet: a fire, during commencement. Emotional beat: Petra realizes history is repeating and he's standing in Orsen's place.

chapters.title: Commencement, in a Minor Key
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, climax. During graduation, smoke rises from the old conservatory levels. Petra takes the stage, plays Orsen's recovered recording over the PA, and tells the whole truth — naming the arsonist's family and his own benefactor — as Wren and Dev help evacuate. Emotional beat: terror transformed into resolve; the truth spoken aloud breaks the loop.

chapters.title: Last Track
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, resolution. The fire gutted the ruins but no one was hurt; Crane resigns, and the school, forced by public truth, restores Orsen's name to the honors wall. Petra loses his scholarship but gains a community that chose him back. The Playlist sends one final song — a thank-you — and goes quiet. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace; loyalty finally aligned with truth.
